verdict.rationale: There is no documented retention-period setting or deletion API for calls, recordings, or transcripts. The only routes to data-lifecycle control are indirect: self-hosting via Docker or Kubernetes keeps data on your own servers, Indian data residency fixes where data lives, and call summaries are an opt-in toggle that is off by default. Missing for 10: configurable retention windows, deletion endpoints for recordings and transcripts, documented data-deletion policy, independent corroboration.
